index.title: Automatic Labeling Tool
index.threshold_desc:
The higher the threshold, the fewer labels are generated, but the accuracy of the labels is higher.
The lower the threshold, the more labels are generated, but the accuracy of the labels decreases.
index.batch_size_desc: It is recommended that the number of images processed in each batch should not be too large.
index.filter_tags_desc: Filtered tags will not be written to the tag group in the file.
index.filter_tags_palceholder: Enter the filter tags (in English), then press Enter to confirm.
index.is_overwrite_desc:
Do not overwrite: Directly skip files that already have tags (this is the fastest option if many files already have tags).
Overwrite: If a tag exists, it will be overwritten (this process is time-consuming).
Merging: Merging will be performed if there are labels (this is the most time-consuming process).
index.read_video_desc:
The video content will be read, and image recognition will be performed on the frames at 1%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 99% of the video duration.
The speed of tagging video files will be significantly reduced.
You need to install ffmpeg from the plugin center beforehand.
index.no_read_video: Do not read the video content
index.splitter_desc: The separator is only needed when both Chinese and English labels are present.
index.splitter_palceholder_mix: The separator is only needed when both Chinese and English labels are present.
index.auto_tagging_desc:
After opening the software, it automatically labels the unlabeled images, using the labeling parameters from the previous labeling session.
Label Override: Do not override
